column1: # MANUALLY MANAGED - the retail base-relocation set DDS.EXE does not carry.
# DDS.EXE was linked /FIXED (IMAGE_FILE_RELOCS_STRIPPED, no .reloc), so the
# absolute DIR32 address operands the delinker needs are SYNTHESIZED: every
# imm32/disp32 of a decoded instruction whose value is an instruction start in
# .text or an address in .rdata/.data (code-imm, code-disp), plus every aligned
# dword outside decoded code with such a value (text-table: jump/pointer tables
# in .text; rdata-ptr; data-ptr). The IAT and import directory are excluded.
# /Zp1 structures also hold pointers at 2-byte offsets the aligned scan skips
# (the panel row handlers); those data-ptr sites are added here by hand.
# Validated at admission: all DIR32 fixups of the 199 uniquely matched VS97 SP3
# LIBC.LIB bodies reproduced, none extra inside them. `giten build` appends these
# as a .reloc section to the build copy build/exe/DDS.EXE (delink/reloc_image.py).
# A false site is removed here; a missed one is added (docs/relocations.md).
